prompt: Low across a card table, 85mm, felt in the near foreground as a teal blur. A silver-haired German American card sharp of about 65, square clean-shaven jaw, duelling scar on one cheek, pale eyes, black waistcoat, faces us three-quarter, unhurried and amused. His far hand is raised out to the side at shoulder height, open, palm up and empty, well away from his mouth. A low copper-shaded lamp lights his face from beneath the shade. Behind him in the soft dark, empty tables and chairs stand in teal-tinged smoke. Full frame, no bars. Thanks.
